statement: First controlled experiment on the orchestration layer itself: a resurrection benchmark built from this repo's own defect history (pre-fix checkout, symptom-only prompt, mechanical ground-truth scoring), comparing solo Claude vs Claude+codex-delegation. acceptanceCriteria.text: Live pilot: every task::arm cell holds >=2 valid runs and the aggregate report says so honestly, or the failure is recorded as-is in docs/

backlog.title: Bench harness, three resurrection task dirs, and the zero-spend calibrate gate
backlog.detail: Everything except the live claude path, per the approved plan: bench/ tree (run-bench.mjs, aggregate.mjs, lib/{manifest,worktree,transplant,headless,score,telemetry,report}.mjs), three task dirs with bench-owned ground-truth tests (D2 job-refs fix abfd9aa parent 59e190c; D3 eperm-rename fix 8ef4058 parent e906cb5; D1 enametoolong fix 9619ebe parent 8a6ea75 with the stdin-or-file bench fixture), symptom.md files with leak-guards, tests/bench-{manifest,runner,report}.test.mjs (hermetic, injected fakes), .gitignore entry for bench/results/, reap prefixes in scripts/reap-test-residue.mjs. Acceptance: the two command criteria above — bench suites green and --calibrate --all proving RED at every parent and GREEN at every fix with no claude invocation.

backlog.title: Smoke run, then the 18-run solo-vs-codex matrix, then the committed report
backlog.detail: Wire runHeadlessClaude + telemetry harvest; --smoke (d3, solo, 1 repeat) first to burn down harness bugs; then 3 tasks x {solo, codex} x 3 repeats sequentially with the approved caps (10-min wall, $2 budget, settings-file plugin gating, scrubbed env, per-run state roots, main-repo fingerprint). Aggregate with the min-samples floor and cost-honesty columns (claude_cost_usd measurable-flagged; delegated tokens never priced). Commit the JSONL snapshot + aggregate as docs/bench-pilot-2026-08-08.md including the caveat block. Arm validity: at least one solo record with zero delegated jobs and one codex record with >=1.
